```{python}
# Setup code
import pandas as pd

import matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
matplotlib.rcParams.update({
    'figure.figsize': (6, 9.5),
    'font.size': 12,
    'figure.constrained_layout.use': True
})

data_source = "external_data/privaterentalaffordability2024.xlsx"
source_df = pd.read_excel(data_source, sheet_name="Table 4", skiprows=2)
source_df = source_df.rename(columns={"Country or region code": "Region code"})
source_df_means = pd.read_excel("external_data/Figure_3_data.xlsx", skiprows=6)
source_df_means = source_df_means.loc[source_df_means["LA_code"] == "-",
                                      source_df_means.columns[~source_df_means.columns.str.startswith("LA_")]]
source_df_means = source_df_means.rename(columns={'Country_or_region_code': "Region code",
                                                  'Country_or_region_name': "Region name",
                                                  'Rental_Affordability': "2023/24"})

asset_themes = {"opaque": "assets_output/",
                "transparent_lightbg": "assets_transparent_lightbg/",
                "transparent_darkbg": "assets_transparent_darkbg/"}
assets_output = asset_themes["opaque"]
output_dir = assets_output
transparent = False
excel_output = {}
```

## Private rented affordability 2024

```{python}
import seaborn.objects as so
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from textwrap import wrap
df = source_df
wrap_width = 13
df["Region wrapped"] = df["Region name"].apply(lambda x: "\n".join(wrap(x, wrap_width)))
region_cols = list(df.columns[df.columns.str.startswith("Region")])
df_region_mean = source_df_means.sort_values(by="2023/24", ascending=False)
df_region_mean["Region wrapped"] = df_region_mean["Region name"].apply(lambda x: "\n".join(wrap(x, wrap_width)))
region_cat = pd.api.types.CategoricalDtype(categories=df_region_mean["Region wrapped"].to_list(), ordered=True)
df["Region wrapped"] = df["Region wrapped"].astype(region_cat)
df_region_mean["Region wrapped"] = df_region_mean["Region wrapped"].astype(region_cat)
df["annotate"] = df["LA name"].isin(["Bristol, City of"])
colours = list(np.array(sns.color_palette("deep"))[np.array([0, 1, 3])])
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(6, 7.5))
fig_title = "Ratio of average rent to median gross income (2023/24)\nfor England/Wales by country/region and local authority"
fig.suptitle(fig_title)
p = (so.Plot(df, x="2023/24", y="Region wrapped")
     .add(so.Dots(fillalpha=0.3, alpha=0.5, color=colours[0], artist_kws={"zorder": 2.5}), so.Jitter(0.5), data=df[~df["annotate"]])
     .add(so.Dots(fillalpha=0.7, alpha=1.0, pointsize=6, color="black", stroke=1.5, fillcolor=colours[1], artist_kws={"zorder": 2.5}),
          so.Jitter(0.5), data=df[df["annotate"]])
     .add(so.Dash(linewidth=2, color=colours[2]), data=df_region_mean)
     .scale(x=so.Continuous().label(like="{x:.0%}"), color=colours)
     .label(x="Affordability ratio", y="")
     .on(fig)
     .plot()
     )
for ax in fig.axes:
    ax.tick_params(axis="y", pad=75)
    ax.set_yticklabels(df_region_mean["Region wrapped"], ha="left")
    annotations = df[df["annotate"]].reset_index(drop=True)
    annotations["LA name"] = annotations["LA name"].str.replace(", City of", "")
    annotations = pd.concat([annotations,
                             (pd.DataFrame(ax.collections[1].get_offsets(), columns=["x", "y"]))],
                            axis=1)
    for idx, row in annotations.iterrows():
        plt.annotate(text=f"{row["LA name"]}: {row["2023/24"]:.1%}",
                     xy=(row["x"], row["y"]),
                     xytext=(row["x"] + 0.08, row["y"] + 0.4),
                     arrowprops=dict(connectionstyle="arc3, rad=0.1",
                                     arrowstyle="->", shrinkA=0, shrinkB=5, relpos=(0, 0.5)),
                     ha="left", va="top")
    ax.axvline(x=30/100, color="black", alpha=0.5, linestyle=(0, (5, 3)), zorder=1.01)
    for x, y in [(0.3, 9.45)]:
        plt.annotate(text="More than 30% is considered unaffordable",
                     fontsize="x-small", alpha=0.5, xy=(x, y), xytext=(x + 0.05, y - 0.2),
                     arrowprops=dict(connectionstyle="arc3, rad=0.1",
                                     arrowstyle="->", shrinkA=0, shrinkB=2, relpos=(0, 0.5),
                                     alpha=0.3),
                     ha="left", va="top")
    for x, y in [(df_region_mean["2023/24"].iloc[-2], len(df_region_mean)-1.65)]:
        plt.annotate(text="Regional average",
                     fontsize="x-small", alpha=0.5, xy=(x, y), xytext=(x + 0.08, y + 0.1),
                     arrowprops=dict(connectionstyle="arc3, rad=-0.1",
                                     arrowstyle="->", shrinkA=0, shrinkB=3, relpos=(0, 0.5),
                                     alpha=0.3),
                     ha="left", va="top")
fig.savefig(assets_output + "Figure_8.1.svg")
plt.show(block=False)
```

## Tables in an Excel file

```{python}
#| output: asis
import os
sheetname = "Sheet1"
qmdfile = os.getenv("QUARTO_DOCUMENT_FILE")
filename = assets_output + qmdfile[:-4]+".xlsx"
with pd.ExcelWriter(filename) as writer:
    next_row = 0
    for k, v in excel_output.items():
        pd.DataFrame([k]).to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheetname, header=False, index=False, startrow=next_row)
        next_row += 1
        v.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheetname, startrow=next_row, float_format="%.1f")
        next_row += (
            (1 if not isinstance(v.columns, pd.MultiIndex) else 1 + len(v.columns.levels))
            + len(v) + 1)
print(f"[Excel file](./{filename})")
```
